typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Satoshi for body text. Numbers in tables or balances MUST use JetBrains Mono or tabular-nums to align correctly. BANNED: Inter, Roboto. Ensure high contrast for readability. Import fonts via Google Fonts or Fontshare.

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Light Variant with Semantic Labels)
colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the semantic_labels. This color separation is a core requirement. Do not use generic colors for badges. Mutasi Internal must look neutral. Drafts must look urgent (Amber). Never use full-screen gradients. Keep UI flat and crisp.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200 on all cards. 8px border-radius (rounded-lg) for a clean, structural look.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal shadows. Use shadow-sm for cards. Use shadow-lg for floating elements like dropdowns and modals.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200) ONLY for the sticky header / balance ticker. All data cards must be Solid White (bg-white) to prevent visual refraction of data.
visual_enhancers.draft_state: Rows in the transaction table that are AI Drafts must have an amber left border (border-l-4 border-amber-400) and an amber background tint (bg-amber-50/50).

layouts.app_structure: Sidebar Navigation (left, fixed, 240px wide) + Main Content Area. Mobile: Top Navbar + Hamburger Menu.
layouts.global_balance_ticker: A sticky section at the top of the Main Content Area (below the page title) that displays all Fund Source balances (Cash, BCA 1, BCA 2, Mandiri, BNI, Other) in a horizontal scrollable row of compact metric cards. THIS IS A CRITICAL REQUIREMENT.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid Protocol - MODE B (High Density). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Top row: Summary totals. Middle row: Cash flow chart (col-span-3) + Recent activity list (col-span-1).
layouts.tables: Dense layout. Remove excessive padding. Use p-2 or p-3 in table cells. Align numbers to the right.
layouts.forms: Transaction Entry must be a side drawer (Shadcn Sheet) that slides in from the right. It must be ONE screen (scrollable inside) without multi-step wizards. Use Tabs to switch between Pemasukan / Pengeluaran / Mutasi. Use File input prominently at the top for AI image ingestion.

components.charts: recharts (wrapped in Shadcn Chart components). Ensure tooltips are fast and crisp.
components.ui_library: Shadcn UI (Button, Input, Select, Table, Dialog, Sheet, Tabs, Badge, Card).
components.instructions_to_main_agent: Do not build custom dropdowns or date pickers. Use Shadcn components. For the Transaction Form, heavily customize the Sheet component to look clean and wide enough (sm:max-w-md or lg:max-w-lg).

motion.transitions: Fast and snappy. Use duration-150 ease-out for hover states.
motion.interactions: Hovering table rows changes background to bg-slate-50. Buttons have a slight scale down on active (active:scale-95).
motion.ai_loading: When an image is uploaded for AI ingestion, show a skeleton loader inside the form fields before populating the Draft data.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. The semantic labels use dark text (e.g., text-emerald-800) on light backgrounds (bg-emerald-100) to ensure readability.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='submit-transaction-btn', data-testid='tab-expense').

login_background.description: Minimalist abstract wavy light background, to be used on the Login screen.

core_features_implementation.1_fund_source_balances: Create a 'BalanceTicker' component placed inside the main layout, rendering small cards for Cash, BCA 1, BCA 2, Mandiri, BNI, Other. Must be visible across all pages.
core_features_implementation.2_ai_draft_review: In the transaction ledger, drafts are listed at the top or highlighted. The user clicks a draft, opening the Drawer form pre-filled. The user verifies the data against the attached image (shown side-by-side or top of form), then clicks 'Simpan Final'.
core_features_implementation.3_event_revenue: Special form fields when 'Event Revenue' is selected: Event Name, Date, Location, PIC. Use conditional rendering in the form.
core_features_implementation.4_debt_receivable: A dedicated page or tab. Shows outstanding amount and a button 'Bayar Cicilan' (Pay Installment) which opens a modal to record partial payments.
core_features_implementation.5_language: All UI text, placeholders, and labels MUST be in Bahasa Indonesia (e.g., 'Simpan', 'Batal', 'Pemasukan', 'Pengeluaran', 'Sumber Dana').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grid logic. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers only.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-lg or pill-shaped) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8) for forms, but keep data tables dense for utility.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
